Constructor that mints initial allocations to private_sale, public_sale, liquidity and the contract itself.

Internal transfer routine that moves balances between sender and recipient.

Attacker-controlled caller address consumed by onlyOwner and transfer paths.

edges.reason: release() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner against msg.sender.
release() reads block.timestamp for its timelock validation.
block.timestamp feeds the release-time comparison operation.
_releaseTime is the stored value compared against block.timestamp.
release() reverts unless block.timestamp >= _releaseTime holds.
max is multiplied and divided to derive every distribution amount.
release() evaluates max * x / 100 arithmetic for each allocation.
release() calls _transfer for each vested allocation.
rewards is used as a recipient address of _transfer.
marketing is used as a recipient address of _transfer.
eco is used as a recipient address of _transfer.
legal is used as a recipient address of _transfer.
charity is used as a recipient address of _transfer.
constructor mints the initial token allocations via _mint.
constructor uses max to size every minted allocation.
constructor mints the 3% private sale allocation to private_sale.
constructor mints the 17% public sale allocation to public_sale.
constructor mints the 7% liquidity allocation to liquidity.
recipient parameter determines the destination of the transfer.
amount parameter determines the quantity moved by the transfer.
sender parameter determines the source account of the transfer.
account parameter receives newly minted tokens.
_checkAndCallTransfer performs an external callback to onTransferReceived.
recipient parameter is the target contract of the external callback.
Reentrant callback can re-enter the token transfer logic.
name_ parameter is forwarded into the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is forwarded into the ERC20 constructor.
release() declares and validates the local amount variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Local scratch variable declared and checked only inside release(), so it collapses into the release function node.
Recipient parameter has no independent behavior and is fully described by the _transfer function it flows through.
Amount parameter is consumed only by _transfer and adds no separate semantic value.
Sender parameter is consumed only by _transfer and should be merged into the function node.
Recipient parameter is the callback target, fully represented by the enclosing _checkAndCallTransfer function.
Constructor argument used only to set the token name, so it merges into the constructor node.
Constructor argument used only to set the token symbol, so it merges into the constructor node.
Beneficiary parameter is used only inside _mint and carries no standalone semantics.
